verdict.rationale: Lithic is API-first. A public endpoint reference documents operations like card creation (POST /cards), alongside dated API versioning via the api-version header, an Events API for managing webhooks, sandbox simulation endpoints, and an llms.txt describing the programmatic interface. An official MCP server also lets AI assistants inspect endpoint schemas and execute live API requests. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
